purpose: Close the remaining obvious daily OHLCV transformation routes without reading local daily values, candidate values, comparator values or returns, and without rescuing a terminal factor by changing its window, direction or estimator.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: daily_overnight_gap_return_refresh
finite_prevalue_catalog.proposed_state: Signal-day daily open relative to the previous close.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The accepted registry already contains gap_1. Recomputing it is an exact old comparator; substituting the standalone historical 09:30 minute row is separately terminal because that row has placeholder semantics.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: signal_day_daily_open_to_close_return
finite_prevalue_catalog.proposed_state: Full-session signed return from the signal-day daily open to close.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Campaign084 already closes this exact design as a window change of terminal late-return and signed close-path families; neither momentum nor reversal direction may be reopened.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: daily_overnight_intraday_gap_digestion_or_disagreement
finite_prevalue_catalog.proposed_state: Interaction, agreement or disagreement between the daily overnight gap and same-session open-to-close move.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: gap_1, intraday_strength and opening_gap_digestion already expose the two components and their digestion state. Agreement, product, ratio, sign split or inversion would only recombine terminal definitions.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: daily_candlestick_body_wick_or_close_location
finite_prevalue_catalog.proposed_state: Daily body efficiency, upper/lower wick asymmetry or closing location inside the daily high-low range.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Campaign014 and earlier frozen audits explicitly close bodies, wick asymmetry, signed candle placement and terminal close location as Campaign009 or close-pressure mechanism refreshes.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: daily_named_ohlc_volatility_estimator_or_disagreement
finite_prevalue_catalog.proposed_state: Parkinson, Garman-Klass, Rogers-Satchell, Yang-Zhang, true-range or estimator-disagreement transforms on daily OHLC.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The accepted registry already has volatility, amplitude and gap families, while Campaign149 closes named OHLC estimator disagreement as deterministic recombination of terminal range, body, gap and volatility operators.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: daily_obv_mfi_cmf_or_range_volume_pressure
finite_prevalue_catalog.proposed_state: On-balance volume, money-flow index, Chaikin-style accumulation/distribution or daily range-volume pressure.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: volume_surge, turnover_surge, liquidity, signed_volume_pressure, return_turnover_correlation, intraday_strength and close-location families already consume the same direction, range and activity inputs. A named cumulative indicator adds a window and normalization search, not a new observed state.

decision.scientific_interpretation: These six routes are rejected as exact old definitions or terminal-family re-expression; Campaign162 does not claim that an unobserved genuinely new daily state is ineffective.

next_action: Record all six scientific rejections and both infrastructure failures append-only, preserve 158/142, and allow Campaign163 only from a genuinely new finite prevalue mechanism or a separately accepted point-in-time source contract.
